authority: Supabase private.content_snapshots and admin RPCs; get_published_content reads the published snapshot. shared/content-store.js is a scoped client projection, not the cloud authority.

rules.published_visibility: Only Video.status=PUBLISHED is projected into the student content list.
rules.identity: Admin and student preserve server IDs; compare video/creator/collection IDs as strings at UI boundaries.
rules.sentences: Admin Sentence.startTime/endTime/english/chinese maps directly to student s/e/en/zh at hydration.
rules.creator: Video.creatorId resolves Creator in the same snapshot, never joins admin drafts to student data. admin_set_creator_status_v1 uses revision CAS to update catalog and restorable trash references atomically; never deletes media.
rules.pipeline: Processing jobs never mutate student learning state; only content metadata/status is shared.
rules.theme: Student uses zs:theme; administrator uses zs:admin:theme independently.
rules.save: Admin creator/collection: prepare -> cloud success -> valid increasing revision -> local commit. Follow/collection/sentence/vocabulary/mastery/removal/review: cloud success and unchanged account -> account-scoped cache. Duplicate saves are guarded; late completions cannot mutate another route or word card. Failure must preserve state and allow retry, never display success.
rules.access: M01 is the only VIP authority. M04 consumes scoped short-lived playback tickets, never arbitrary R2 paths or full access tokens in cookies.
rules.account_switch: Learning hydration checks request generation and current session ID. Async saves also check account, route and connected DOM.

field_map.student: POST /api/session -> scoped cookie -> authorized HLS; single balanced-540-v1 rendition
published video attribution, recommendations and creator profile
published collection cards/detail and saved collection routes

verification: audit/verify_balanced_media.mjs (production media checks plus test session login/logout)
known_gaps: Real iOS/WeChat devices and regional mobile networks remain unverified.
